title: Market pulse
loadFailed: Market data is temporarily unavailable. Use refresh to try again.
connectionLost: Connection lost. Showing earlier quotes; sentiment will return after a successful refresh.
insufficient: At least two current-session index quotes are needed.
source: Tencent Finance · quotes may be delayed · times shown in each market's local time.
method: Squabble estimates sentiment from the equal-weight average daily change of the indices above. Score = 50 + 20 × average change (%), limited to 0–100. Only valid quotes from the same latest session are included. This is a price-momentum proxy, not an official Fear & Greed Index or a trading signal.
timing: Refreshes every minute. Closed markets retain their latest session date. Failed refreshes are marked stale and excluded from the score; last available values are kept for up to 24 hours.
